description:
Browse, filter and search the server list. One page of servers with the same filters, ordering and five-minute cache as the servers.rustprofit.com
list and its hub pages (/country/de, /vanilla, /solo, /gather/2x ...). Each result is the full public server
record: identity and connect details (`ip`, `game_port`, `query_port`, `connect` as a `steam://` URI), `map`,
`world_seed`, `world_size`, `country`/`country_name`, live `current_players`/`max_players`/`queued_players`,
the `kind` (official/modded/vanilla) and `is_*` flags, `password_protected`, `vac_enabled`, `gather_rate` with
its `gather_bucket`, `group_limit` with its `group` label, `tags`, owner-supplied `description` (first 500
characters), `banner_url`, `website_url`, `discord_url`, `first_seen_at`/`last_seen_at`/`last_polled_at`, the
aggregates `votes`, `rating` (1-5 average, null when unrated) and `last_wipe_at`, and the server's page `url`
plus embeddable `widget_url`/`badge_url`. Ties in every sort are broken by `id` so pages never overlap.

biome.description: Only servers whose generated map preview is mostly this biome (its percentage is the highest of the five).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the server is hosted in (GeoIP of its address); `/servers/countries` lists the values in use.

gather.description: Gather-rate bucket parsed from the server name: `2x` (2-2.99), `3x` (3-4.99), `5x` (5-9.99) or `10x` (10 and above). Servers with no `Nx` in their name never match.

group.description: Team-size cap: `solo` (1), `duo` (2) or `trio` (3). Only servers whose cap is known match.

kind.description: `vanilla` = not modded; `modded` = reports a modded flag over A2S; `official` = a Facepunch-run public server (by name convention).

min_players.description: Only servers with at least this many players online right now.

min_rating.description: Only servers whose average community rating (1-5) is at least this.

monument.description: Only servers whose current map (when a preview has been generated) contains this monument type, exactly as `/servers/monument-types` lists it.

online.description: `true` (default) = only servers that were online at their last poll; `false` = only servers currently marked offline.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the server name.

sort.description: `players` = most players online first (default); `votes` = most community votes; `rating` = highest average rating; `wiped` = most recently wiped; `name` = alphabetical.

name: search_servers
title: Browse, filter and search the server list
